purpose: One heading-bounded chapter of an article body (the intro before the first h2, then one node per h2 chapter): rich-text column (681 wide on posts, 641 on events, 832-col on stories) exercising h2/h3/h4, p, strong/em, links, lists, blockquote, inline code, a code block, an image, a table and a 16:9 embed. Repeatable; in the clone the text is neutral placeholder copy.
evidenceNote: cms-templates.md line 9: article, story and event bodies were not copied; PlaceholderBody renders lorem text with the measured rich-text styles.

responsive.change: body width follows the column (681 only at >=1100)

notes: Used by 78 routes (62 posts, 12 stories, 4 events). The real article/story/event copy is intentionally absent from the source project, so no word budget can be derived; PageSpec carries bodyMode "placeholder" only.

Decomposed per chapter (R6): measured at 1440 the whole body was 2996 / 5025 px on a blog post (60%) and 3482 / 5191 px on an event (67%). Each node now stands for one heading-bounded chapter (5 on every measured page: intro + 4 h2 chapters, src/components/cms/PlaceholderBody.jsx PLACEHOLDER_HEADINGS).
